chapters.title: How long, O Lord?
chapters.summary: Habakkuk asks why God allows violence and injustice in Judah. God answers that He is raising up the Babylonians, and the prophet asks how a holy God can use such a cruel nation.

chapters.title: The just shall live by faith
chapters.summary: God tells Habakkuk to write the vision plainly and wait for it. The proud will fail, but the just shall live by his faith. The earth will be filled with the knowledge of His glory.

chapters.title: Yet I will rejoice
chapters.summary: Habakkuk prays, remembering God's mighty acts. Though the fig tree does not blossom and the fields yield no food, yet I will rejoice in the Lord.
